verdict.summary: Round 2 finds no actionable correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect. The boolean builder derives the verdict, pins the xsd:boolean datatype constant, and reuses the existing u64 relation consistently with boolean hooks 0/1. Tests cover the full truth table, host/member leaf rebinding, bidirectional datatype-lane separation, fail-closed input and dispatch behavior, serialization/layout, and real witness acceptance/rejection when nargo is available; the feature-matrix leg exercises the gated suite. Public documentation preserves the INV-VL, CR-G8/sq-qhy4, and external-audit caveats. Relative to round 1, the findings remain materially unchanged at zero, so progress is stagnant.
